name: Vesperal-Scree
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against bioluminescent seas, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the ancient alien ruins left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
For traders, medicinal compounds and exotic matter alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
